SAMPSON HEAVY DIESEL SERVICES · VICTORIA

Field service for trucks and machinery

Mobile heavy diesel support for trucks, heavy equipment and agricultural machinery across Victoria. Call Clive with your location, equipment details and symptoms to discuss the next step.

Call Clive · 0474 372 852

Provide the location and access details

Give the site address, road, nearest town, suburb or postcode. A map pin can help explain a remote location. Tell Clive whether the vehicle or machine is beside a road, in a yard, on a farm or at a worksite, and describe any access restrictions.

For an immediate emergency or danger, call 000. This website does not provide emergency dispatch or confirm that a vehicle or machine is safe to operate.

Describe the equipment and symptoms

  • Vehicle or machine make, model and identifying details.
  • What happened before it stopped or the warning appeared.
  • Warning messages, noises, leaks or loss of drive.
  • Any attached equipment, trailer or site access requirements.
  • Your current location and a contact number.

Clive will discuss availability and whether field service is suitable. Attendance, timing and travel arrangements are confirmed directly.

Establish a suitable repair arrangement

The fault, safe access, equipment and parts requirements affect where work can be performed. Some jobs may require a workshop assessment, component removal or another arrangement. Calling first helps establish a practical next step.

For an urgent mechanical issue, call to check availability. Text messages may not be seen immediately.

Melbourne and regional Victoria

Use the Victoria suburb and postcode lookup to help identify a location. For a remote farm or worksite, provide the nearest town and access instructions as well.

For planned work, see truck servicing, heavy equipment servicing or agricultural machinery servicing.
